lines.text: The Lamb stands on Mount Zion with 144,000 who have His name and His Father's name on their foreheads.
A flying angel proclaims the eternal gospel to every nation and says to fear God, because the hour of His judgment has come.
A second angel announces that Babylon has fallen, and a third warns that worshipers of the beast will drink the wine of God's mercy.
One like the Son of Man sits on a white cloud with a golden crown and a sharp rod, and the earth is harvested.
An angel gathers the grapes of the earth and throws them into the great winepress of God's wrath, trodden outside the city.
